body:
I would remove the public example url, it was here only to be able to demo the current prototype easily. And stop publishing it to gh-pages also.

To our developers, users, public the integration we will show will be the instant search demo built with instantsearch.js. This will be our documentation and main example, not the example/.

The example/ was mostly done to ease the development process.

Trying to make our development example readable for the public (that do not go to github) is no more necessary if there's no running version of it.

If we try to make it somehow readable what we will endup with is more issues and FUD in our development process.

> Ideally, I would remove webpack from the app.js

Yes me too, that's why that's not what we should show to the public, but this: https://github.com/algolia/instant-search-demo/blob/feat/instantsearch.js-implementation/app.js.

I am 👎 for this PR
